content: {"summary":"fraud-scorer-02 was OOMKilled roughly every 11 minutes because the Deployment did not set WEB_CONCURRENCY, so the pod started 32 gunicorn workers on a 32‑core node, exceeding its 3 GiB memory limit; setting WEB_CONCURRENCY to 16 halved the workers and stopped the OOM loop.","likely_cause":"WEB_CONCURRENCY unset, leading to 32 gunicorn workers that exceed the pod’s memory limit","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"WEB_CONCURRENCY was unset, causing 32 gunicorn workers on a 32‑core node, which exceeded the pod’s memory limit.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"WEB_CONCURRENCY is not set in the Deployment, so the entrypoint starts one gunicorn worker per CPU it can see: 32."},{"text":"The OOMKilled occurred about every 11 minutes, matching the time for ~20 workers to warm up and hit the 3 GiB limit.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#2"],"quote":"The kill came once about 20 workers had warmed up, which is why each start lasted about 11 minutes."},{"text":"Setting WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 reduced workers to 16 and stopped the OOM loop.","evidence_ids":["INC-0163#1"],"quote":"Found it 02:30 WEB_CONCURRENCY=16 set in the Deployment; rollout 02:40 both pods running 16 workers"}],"next_checks":["Verify that all Deployments using gunicorn set an explicit WEB_CONCURRENCY value","Monitor worker count and memory usage after the change","Check other services on mixed 16‑ and 32‑core nodes for similar defaults","Confirm redis latency and tracemalloc remain normal post‑fix"]}
